_note: Video files live in public/std/. Astro does not process video, so public/ is correct here — but nothing optimises them either. These are transcoded from 2416x3432 / 8.9 Mbps masters down to 1208x1716 / ~1.24 Mbps, which is indistinguishable at 2x on both static type and mid-animation and turns 12MB into 1.8MB. A filename containing DRAFT fails the strict build.
